question: What are your business hours?
answer: Our support team is available Monday to Friday from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM IST, and Saturday from 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM IST.

question: How do I track my order?
answer: Once your order ships, we send a tracking link via email and SMS. You can also track it anytime using your Order ID on our website.

question: What is your return and refund policy?
answer: Unused items in original packaging can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund or exchange.

question: How long does a refund take to process?
answer: After we inspect your returned item, refunds are processed within 5 to 7 business days to your original payment method.

question: What payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept UPI, credit and debit cards, net banking, and major digital wallets.

question: Do you charge shipping fees?
answer: Standard shipping is free on orders above ₹999; orders below ₹999 have a flat ₹79 shipping fee.

question: How long does standard delivery take?
answer: Standard delivery usually takes 3 to 5 business days within metro cities and 5 to 7 business days for other locations.

question: Do you offer express or same-day delivery?
answer: Express shipping (1 to 2 business days) is available in select pin codes for an additional fee at checkout.

question: Can I cancel or change my order after placing it?
answer: You can cancel or update your shipping address within 2 hours of placing the order before it enters dispatch.

question: How do I reset my account password?
answer: Click Forgot Password on the login page, enter your registered email address, and follow the reset link sent to your inbox.

question: How do I update my email or phone number?
answer: Log in to your account, go to Profile Settings, edit your contact details, and verify via the OTP sent to your new contact.

question: Do you offer warranty on electronics and accessories?
answer: Yes, all electronics and accessories include a 1-year manufacturer warranty covering hardware defects.

question: How do I claim a warranty replacement?
answer: Share your order invoice and a short video or description of the issue with support to start a warranty claim.

question: What should I do if I receive a damaged or wrong item?
answer: Please share photos of the item and packaging within 48 hours of delivery so we can arrange a free replacement or pickup.

question: Do you sell gift cards or e-vouchers?
answer: Yes, digital gift cards in denominations from ₹500 to ₹5,000 are available on our store and never expire.

question: How do I apply a promo code or coupon?
answer: Enter your promo code in the Discount / Coupon box on the checkout page and click Apply before completing payment.

question: Why did my promo code not work?
answer: Promo codes may not apply if the cart value is below the minimum spend, the item is already on clearance, or the offer has expired.

question: Do you ship internationally?
answer: Currently we ship across India and do not offer direct international shipping.

question: How can I contact a human support agent?
answer: You can email support@example-store.com or call our helpline during business hours if your issue needs human review.

question: Can I schedule a delivery for a specific date?
answer: Scheduled delivery slots are available in select cities during checkout depending on courier availability.

question: What happens if I miss a delivery attempt?
answer: The courier partner will automatically reattempt delivery on the next business day up to two times before returning the package.

question: How do I check if an item is back in stock?
answer: Open the product page and click Notify Me to receive an email alert as soon as the item is restocked.

question: Are invoices provided with every order?
answer: Yes, a GST-compliant tax invoice is emailed automatically and can be downloaded from your order history.

question: Can I exchange a product for a different size or color?
answer: Yes, size or color exchanges are free within 15 days of delivery subject to stock availability.

question: How do I delete my account?
answer: Submit an account deletion request from Privacy Settings or contact support; personal data is removed within 14 business days.

question: Is my payment and personal data secure?
answer: Yes, all transactions use encrypted payment gateways and we never store full card or UPI PIN details.

question: Do you have physical retail stores?
answer: We operate primarily online, with select experience pop-ups announced on our social channels.

question: What if my package shows delivered but I haven't received it?
answer: Check with neighbors or building security first, then contact us within 24 hours so we can investigate with the courier.

question: Can I add items to an existing order?
answer: Once an order is confirmed, new items cannot be added directly; please place a separate order or cancel within 2 hours.

question: How do I unsubscribe from promotional emails?
answer: Click the Unsubscribe link at the bottom of any promotional email to opt out of marketing messages.
